raw: {"note": "The proposed changes (DEPTH, MATRIX_LR, WARMUP_RATIO, ASPECT_RATIO) are ordinary architecture/optimizer tuning that leave the fixed evaluation untouched (EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_TOKENS, EVAL_SPLIT unchanged) and training still uses shards 0-9, so val_bpb keeps measuring real held-out quality.", "verdict": "ok"}

parsed.note: The proposed changes (DEPTH, MATRIX_LR, WARMUP_RATIO, ASPECT_RATIO) are ordinary architecture/optimizer tuning that leave the fixed evaluation untouched (EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_TOKENS, EVAL_SPLIT unchanged) and training still uses shards 0-9, so val_bpb keeps measuring real held-out quality.
